title: POI Signals
subtitle: Routes are leads, not guarantees
summary: POI signals point toward salvage, caches, faction edges, or future hazards. Each signal needs a reason to visit and a reason to wait.
body: Early POIs should provide survival supplies, route records, repair material, or scanner intel.
Late first-month POIs such as data centers and reactor ruins should stay marked as future or hazard routes until prep is complete.
If a POI is referenced but not implemented, it should stay locked, hidden, or clearly labeled as future.
